source_analysis.skill: Rearrange a first-order ODE to separate x and y; integrate; use an initial condition to determine the integration constant and, where necessary, the solution branch.
reasoning_steps: Algebraically rearrange/factor the displayed equation into f(y)dy=g(x)dx.
Integrate using elementary power, logarithmic, exponential or trigonometric antiderivatives.
Substitute the initial x and y to determine the integration constant.
Return the particular explicit or implicit relation, or the requested expression in its scaffold; choose sign from the initial condition when applicable.
invariants: First-order separable ODE and elementary integration at the observed workload.
Initial point lies in the equation domain; an implicit formal antiderivative must actually define a differentiable local IVP solution.
Exactly one mathematically valid radio answer; key satisfies original ODE and initial condition.
Prompt, answer bank, scaffold and worked solution use a single consistent instance.
permitted_variations: Small signed coefficients, powers within the observed integration workload, admissible initial x and y values, and integration constants.
Positive/negative solution branch where source allows both by initial condition; denominator or logarithm argument must follow the initial condition.
Radio ordering and which candidate satisfies both the ODE and initial condition; particular source correct position is incidental.
Zero and nonzero integration constants are both eligible when valid.
Changes to ODE coefficients should change dependent antiderivatives, banks and solutions; answer order or equivalent formatting should not change mathematical correctness.
